message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes. All of them are located in or near the city’s downtown/West Loop area, so you’ll have plenty of other dining options nearby as well.

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|-------|
| **Siam Thai** | 111 W. Wabash Ave., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Vegetarian Spring Rolls, Veggie Tom Yum Soup* | Classic Thai fare with a dedicated vegetarian menu. Great for both dine‑in and take‑out. |
| **Baan Thai** | 1120 N. Clark St., Chicago, IL 60610 | (312) 444-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Cozy spot with a full vegetarian menu. They also offer a “vegetarian” version of many signature dishes. |
| **Siam Square** | 111 W. Wabash Ave., 1st Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Located in the same building as Siam Thai; slightly more casual vibe. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 111 W. Wabash Ave., 3rd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Massaman Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | A bit more upscale, but still offers a solid vegetarian selection. |
| **Siam Thai (West Loop)** | 111 W. Wabash Ave., 2nd Floor, Chicago, IL 60602 | (312) 444-7777 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai, Tofu Green Curry, Veggie Spring Rolls, Vegetarian Tom Yum* | Same as the main Siam Thai location; just a note that it’s in the West Loop. |

### Quick Tips for Vegetarian Dining at Thai Restaurants

1. **Ask for “Vegetarian” or “No Meat”** – Most Thai restaurants will happily adjust a dish to exclude meat or seafood.  
2. **Look for “Tofu” or “Vegetable” in the name** – Many places label their vegetarian dishes explicitly.  
3. **Check the menu online** – Most of the above restaurants post their menus on their websites or on Google Maps, so you can see vegetarian options before you go.  
4. **Try the “Vegetarian” versions of classic dishes** – Pad Thai, Green Curry, Massaman Curry, and Tom Yum Soup are often available with tofu or vegetable substitutions.  

### How to Get There

All of these restaurants are within a short walk or a quick ride from the Loop. If you’re using public transit, the nearest CTA stations are:

- **Wabash Station** (Red Line) – 111 W. Wabash Ave.  
- **Clark/Lake Station** (Blue Line) – 1120 N. Clark St.  

Feel free to call ahead or check their websites for current hours and any reservation requirements. Enjoy your Thai meal!
